# Yassine El Ouazzani Portfolio

## About Me
Yassine El Ouazzani is a Full-Stack & Mobile Developer specializing in mobile application development and responsive full-stack web platforms. He has a Specialized Degree in Digital Development (Mobile Applications) from OFPPT - ISTAG Bab Tizimi.

## Tech Stack
* Mobile: Kotlin, Flutter, Dart, Android SDK
* Frontend: React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS
* Backend & Systems: Go, Python, Flask, TypeScript, Node.js
* Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis, SQLite, Supabase, Firebase
* DevOps & Tools: Linux, Docker, Git

## Selected Projects
* mehro-paste: Fast, zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted paste sharing with burn-on-read. Built with Next.js, Libsodium WASM, and Redis.
* Sentinel: A resilient Dead Man's Switch platform with a Go API backend and Flutter mobile client.
* ORA: An open-source Android countdown app with Material You design and home screen widgets.
* Moroccan Educational System: Standardized JSON dataset of the Moroccan national curriculum.
* Laboratoire AL AMAL: Trilingual production website for an accredited medical analysis laboratory.
